[element-conf-date]
=== `<conf-date>` Conference Date (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), the date(s) on which a conference was held.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Best Practice

Conference dates in standards bibliography can be stored in one of two forms: as a single date (“May 1906”), or as the first day and last day of the conference. Either form can be stored in the `<conf-date>` element. Dates that originate as separate first and last elements in the source should be combined.

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
